about_short_description.short_description: Sleeper is a sports platform intended for fantasy leagues and eSports.

product.name: Sleeper Fantasy Football
product.description: A fantasy football platform for creating and managing leagues, drafting players, setting lineups, trading, and tracking live scores across redraft, keeper, dynasty, best-ball, and other formats.

product.name: Sleeper PICKS
product.description: A daily fantasy sports pick’em product where users select whether player statistics will be higher or lower than listed projections across supported professional and college sports contests.

product.name: Sleeper Fantasy Basketball
product.description: A fantasy basketball platform for drafting NBA players, managing rosters and lineups, and competing in private or public leagues with live scoring and standings.

product.name: Sleeper Fantasy Soccer
product.description: A fantasy soccer service for managing leagues based on competitions such as the English Premier League and LaLiga, including player selection and performance tracking.

product.name: Sleeper Bracket Mania
product.description: A bracket-prediction game in which users select teams across a tournament, join public or private pools, and compare results through live scoring and rankings.

product.name: Sleeper Chopped Leagues
product.description: A fantasy league format with weekly eliminations in which participants compete to retain roster spots and may acquire players from eliminated teams.
